name: Add-on Popularity
query:
SELECT
    addon.item AS "Add-On Type:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:200",
    COUNT(addon.item) AS "Sold Count:Int:120"

FROM
    `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item` AS addon

INNER JOIN
    `tabAirplane Ticket` AS ticket
    ON ticket.name = addon.parent

WHERE
    addon.parenttype = 'Airplane Ticket'
    AND addon.parentfield = 'add_ons'
    AND ticket.docstatus = 1

GROUP BY
    addon.item

ORDER BY
    COUNT(addon.item) DESC
